==Standard dialogue==

** '''Abbot Langley:''' Ok.
** {{tbox|Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?}}
** '''Player:''' Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
** '''Abbot Langley:''' We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|cond=If the player has not joined the Edgeville Monastery order:|How do I get further into the monastery?}}

**** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|Oh, sorry.}}
** '''Player:''' Oh, sorry.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Can you help with spirit shields?}}

** '''Player:''' Can you remove the sigils from my spirit shields?
** '''Abbot Langley:''' I think I shoud be able to manage that. However in doing so, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy the blessed shield itself. You'll only get the sigil back.
** '''Abbot Langley:''' I can go ahead and break down all of the shields in your inventory now if you'd like?.{{sic}}
** {{tselect|Are you sure?}}
** {{topt|Yes.}}

*** {{tact|end}}

==Claiming the Corrupted Helm==
* '''Abbot Langley:''' Ah, I was told to expect you, please take this as thanks!
* {{tbox|pic=Corrupted helm detail.png|Abbot Langley quickly takes the soft clay, leather boots and bowl of hot water in exchange for a mysterious helmet.}}
* {{tact|receives=Corrupted helm}}
* {{tact|end}}
